identity.description_short: Generates high-dimensional vectors for multimodal retrieval and clustering from text, images, videos, or mixed inputs.

description: The Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B is a multi-modal embedding model designed to generate semantically rich vectors that capture both visual and textual information. It accepts diverse inputs including text, images, screenshots, videos, and arbitrary multimodal combinations, supporting over 30 languages with up to 4096 dimensions. While it excels in tasks like image-text retrieval and visual question answering, its primary function is initial recall within a two-stage pipeline where it is typically paired with a reranker model.
name: qwen3-vl-embedding-8b
